subject: Crunch window: 20-minute lightning demo slot & contingency matrix
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Tran <amelia@supercloud.ai>; Jake Moreno <jake@eventops.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crunch window: 20-minute lightning demo slot & contingency matrix

Hi Amelia / Jake —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our Aug 18 webinar ("Scaling LLMs in the Wild"). We have a compact 20-minute demo slot in the middle of the show and I want to lock the plan so we can share assets with marketing and ops. Quick asks below — please reply with confirmations by EOD Friday so we can finalize the run-of-show.

High level (what we need from you):
- Live demo or pre-recorded: tell us preference. If live, can you do screen share + audio?
- Slides: 6 slides max. Please use our template (attached: slide-guidelines.pdf).
- Recording: we record and may repurpose the clip. Are you ok with that?
- Tech check: 30 min slot between Aug 16–17 (we’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm availability).

Contingency we plan to run if live demo fails: play a 6-minute highlight reel, pivot to a short Q&A and follow up with a post-webinar deep-dive session with your team. Karthik is looping in ops to finalize failover.

Attachments: slide-guidelines.pdf (branding + timing instructions).

Amelia/Jake — can you confirm: live vs pre-recorded, slide delivery by Aug 13, and at least one tech-check time?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Amelia Tran <amelia@supercloud.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crunch window: 20-minute lightning demo slot & contingency matrix

Thanks Lauren — happy to take the 20-minute lightning demo. A few notes from our side:

- We prefer live, but well prep a short 6-min fallback clip (we can provide MP4) in case network/API calls time out.
- Slides: well do 6 slides and follow your template. Can you confirm max file size for upload?
- Demo environment: we usually demo against our staging endpoint (staging.supercloud.ai). For this session we can either show the live staging or upload a snapshot container. Ive attached our internal demo environment spec (supercloud-demo-env-spec.md) with ports and recommended bandwidth.
- Tech check: Aug 17 at 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead. If that conflicts, Aug 16 afternoon is okay too.

Recording permission: yes, you may record and use the clip.

One ask for flow: wed like a single on-stage moderator prompt at the start of the demo (30s intro) and a 4–5 minute moderated Q&A right after.

Appreciate it — will upload slides by Aug 13 and confirm final demo approach by EOD Aug 12.

Best,
Amelia Tran
Director of Machine Learning | SuperCloud AI
amelia@supercloud.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Tran <amelia@supercloud.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crunch window: 20-minute lightning demo slot & contingency matrix

Hi team — thanks for the details, Amelia. Im putting together a compact run-of-show and a contingency matrix so production can flip instantly if anything goes sideways. Key items attached (run-of-show-compact.xlsx). Summary below:

Planned flow (20 mins):
- 00:00–00:30 Host intro (Lauren)
- 00:30–04:00 Moderator handoff + context (Marissa)
- 04:00–14:00 Live demo (Amelia) — screen share + 2 short prompts well provide
- 14:00–18:30 Q&A (moderated)
- 18:30–20:00 Closing + CTA

Contingency matrix (short):
- If demo environment stalls (>45s error): auto-play 6-min highlight reel -> moderator-led Q&A -> promise of a detailed follow-up session with SuperCloud.
- If audio cuts: switch to pre-recorded voiceover + slides (we keep deck in stage hands).
- If presenter cannot join last-minute: we slot in a panel discussion and surface the pre-recorded clip.

Operational asks for Amelia:
- Confirm staging vs container snapshot by EOD Aug 12. If staging, please whitelist these IPs: 34.82.11.140, 34.82.11.141.
- Share preferred presenter name + 1-line bio + headshot by Aug 13 (for slide lower-third).
- Drop the 6-min fallback MP4 to the Drive folder linked below by Aug 15.

Well schedule the tech check Aug 17 10:00 PT (provisionally) and send a calendar invite; calendar link included in metadata. Also tagging Soojin for camera/stream checks and Marissa for moderation script.

Onwards — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Platform Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Amelia Tran <amelia@supercloud.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crunch window: 20-minute lightning demo slot & contingency matrix

Perfect, thanks everyone.

- Were confirmed live demo (staging endpoint). Ill ask infra to whitelist the IPs you sent.
- Slides, bio, and headshot will be uploaded to the Drive folder by Aug 13.
- Fallback MP4 will be ready by Aug 15.
- Tech check Aug 17 10:00 PT confirmed. Our eng lead (Tom Nguyen) will join — Ill share his contact.

See you at the tech check — appreciate the crisp contingency plan.

Best,
Amelia
